messages:
kevin: Heads-up — I'm seeing a bunch of tenant-512 spikes hitting the new 'embed credits' leaky-bucket and getting fast-failed even though Console shows available GPU capacity.

maria: Can you paste an example request payload + headers? curious if units estimator is undercounting dims or bytes.

kevin: Payload excerpt: `{"inputs": ["..." * 40], "model": "embedding-xl"}`. Header: `X-Embed-Units: 8` but runtime metrics show ~24 units.

alex: That sounds like estimator mismatch. The bytes->units heuristic was tuned for small dims; mixed dims can triple the estimate if the client sends wide rows.

maria: Right — console's credits graph aggregates daily bucket refills so short bursts look OK. But the leaky-bucket drain is per-second. UI doesn't show sub-minute reservoir, so users see 'available credits' and get surprised.

kevin: Exactly. Tenant hits 413 fastfail, then files a support ticket referring to Console. Bad UX.

danielle: Proposal: add a 'burst buffer' line on the quota card showing current reservoir + refill rate and a tooltip: "Short spikes > buffer will be throttled even if monthly allowance remains." Also expose last-minute drain rate in the timeline.

alex: Telemetry note — our sampled telemetry drops large payloads at 1/100 to save bandwidth, which biases the estimator. Suggest temporarily increase sampling for embed routes for next 48h to validate.

srebot: Deploy notice: canary of leaky-bucket-v2 scheduled for 03:45 UTC. Flag: `ingress.embed.leaky_v2`.

maria: Implementation detail for console: we can compute reservoir = min(allowance, refill_rate * window). Do we want window=60s? 120s? UX will matter.

danielle: Start with 60s, but allow per-tenant override via admin console for enterprise. Also add a red badge when expected drain > refill for 60s.

kevin: For rollout: perf canary on 5% traffic with `leaky_v2` true + telemetry sampling bumped to 1/10 for embed endpoints. I'll create the canary PR.

alex: Also add a chart in the route dashboard showing estimator vs actual runtime units per request (percentile lines). That will help validate heuristics.

maria: FYI SDK fastfail behavior: when we start returning 429 vs 413 the client library falls back differently. Keep an eye on SDK behavior for our error codes.

danielle: Good call. Add a telemetry tag `client_sdk_behavior=fastfail-429` during canary so we can correlate.

kevin: I'll open the PR and include a small runbook: how to revert if errors > 0.5% or average latency increases > 30ms.

maria: Thanks — canary timeline and dashboards please. I'll own the console UX bits.

alex: TL;DR: estimator sampling bias + console aggregation mismatch -> confusing UX. Plan: bump sampling for 48h, canary leaky_v2 to 5%, add reservoir visualization and minute-level drain in console, and route-level estimator vs runtime chart.

kevin: sounds good. tagging @srebot for the canary window. :thumbsup:
